changes: Modules: switch built-in features (dashboard, deals & pipelines, reports, lead forms, tasks, automations, email & calendar, AI assistant) on and off for the whole workspace, with dependency checks and per-module configuration. Disabling never deletes data.

Appearance: accent color with a generated palette, neutral grays, radius, density, font, sidebar style, buttons, contrast, default light / dark mode, logo, favicon, custom CSS and seven presets, applied live for every user.

Extensions: install modules (pages, record tabs, dashboard widgets, settings pages, AI tools, automation actions, hooks) and themes at runtime from a ZIP, stored in the CRM's own data; enable, disable, upgrade, export, uninstall; safe mode (?safe=1 or Shift).

CLI: modules list|get|enable|disable|config, appearance get|presets|set|preset|logo|favicon|css|reset, ext new|check|pack|install|list|enable|disable|uninstall|export; every workspace-wide change prints a plan unless --yes.
CLI and MCP sessions load the site's enabled extensions: their AI tools are in tools list / MCP tools/list, their hooks and automation actions run (automations run). --safe skips them.

MCP: new resources agentcrm://modules and agentcrm://appearance; customisation tools list_modules, set_module_enabled, get_appearance, set_appearance, apply_appearance_preset, list_extensions, set_extension_enabled.

New skill agentcrm-extensions (scaffold, recipes, check, pack, install); agentcrm-admin covers modules, appearance and extensions. Docs: extensions, creating a module / theme, runtime API reference, appearance, modules.
actions: Update the agent skills (Claude Code: /plugin marketplace update agentcrm) to get the customisation and extension commands.
Redeploy the admin (agentcrm deploy-admin) to get Settings → Modules and Settings → Appearance.

changes: First release: static CRM (companies, people, deals, pipelines, activities, tasks, custom objects and fields, views, automations, lead forms, reports) with an admin that runs entirely in the browser.
Data on storage you own: encrypted journal on S3-compatible buckets, private GitHub / GitLab repos or a local folder; git-json and Firebase backends.
agentcrm CLI: install from a plan, doctor, deploy-admin, records / schema / pipelines / views / users / settings, CSV import and export, reports, automations, forms, compaction (GDPR erasure).
MCP server (agentcrm mcp) exposing the AI tool catalog, schema / pipeline resources and sales prompts.
Claude Code plugin with four skills (install, manage, admin, sales) and generated Hermes Agent skills.
